notes: Shopify storefront, robots.txt fully open (User-agent: * Allow: /); HTTP-first tier (curl + sitemap/products.json) was sufficient throughout, no Playwright/Chrome needed. Method: (1) pulled sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (1650 collection URLs) and grepped exhaustively for Diwali/Christmas/Halloween/Holi/Raksha Bandhan/Eid/New Year/Valentine's/Mother's-Father's Day/Navratri/etc, alone and combined with 'home'; (2) pulled the live global nav/mega-menu (homepage + /collections/home, identical 253-link set) and confirmed zero seasonal/holiday terms appear in current navigation; (3) checked sitemap_pages_1.xml for lookbook/editorial pages. Findings: no Home-department seasonal category currently has live products. Diwali specifically: no dedicated Home Diwali collection exists anywhere in nav or sitemap; the only Diwali collections found are fashion-scoped ('Ethnic Wear for Diwali 2023/2025', 8x 'X Diwali Outfits for Women 2023' color variants) - all fashion, not Home. Two Diwali-Home *pages* exist (/pages/home-diwali-brochure, /pages/diwali-home-lookbook) but these are lookbook/editorial page-type content with no unique product or collection links (diffed against global nav, 0 unique links) - fail the genuine-PLP test, not a category. Site search 'diwali home' returns 31 generic keyword-matched results (not a curated PLP) - used only as supplementary confirmation, not primary evidence, since nav+sitemap were already checked per rules. Three genuine Home-scoped seasonal collection shells were found and verified real (HTTP 200, vs 404 for a nonsense-slug control; distinct og:titles): 'Eid Home' (/collections/eid-home), 'Home Holiday Collection' (/collections/home-holiday-collection), 'Home Gifting' aka home-feel-festive (/collections/home-feel-festive) - all three return 0 products via products.json (confirmed empty product grid in rendered HTML too: '0 items'/'no-results'). These fail criterion 'lists products' and were excluded as currently-empty/dormant (likely populated only during the actual festival window; today is 2026-09-04, off-season for Diwali/Eid/Christmas). Also checked and excluded as out-of-scope: 'christmas-collection-outfits-gifts-home-decor' (2 products, both fashion - Jackets/Sweaters, 0 home items despite name) and 'christmas-edit-festive-decor-gifts-fashion-online' (~154 products, all fashion product_types, 0 home) - mixed-department pages with 'home decor' only in marketing copy, no actual home inventory. General cross-department gifting collections (rakhi-gifts, the-rakhi-edit, mothers-day-special, mothers-day-gift, fathers-day-special, valentines-day-gifts, halloween-costumes) sampled via product_type breakdown are dominated by Perfumes/Beauty/Footwear/Apparel with at most 1-2 incidental 'Decor' items per ~40-60 sampled - these are site-wide gift-occasion collections spanning all departments, not a Home-department seasonal taxonomy node, so excluded per task's 'scope strictly to Home department' instruction. 'gifts-for-house' (711 products, og:title 'Buy Best House Gifts') is a generic year-round home-gifting category with no holiday association - not seasonal. Conclusion: as of this check, Westside Home has no currently valid (populated) Home-department seasonal/holiday category page. Flagged in qa_notes.md as an open item: the three dormant Home-scoped seasonal shells (Eid Home / Home Holiday Collection / Home Gifting) are genuine taxonomy nodes that may populate closer to each festival - worth a re-check nearer Diwali/Eid/Christmas 2026 if the project revisits companies.
